capabilities.rb1_scope: Full Richards REFERENCE route in the frozen RB1 hydraulic/profile scope; SWKIMPL=0, SWSOPHY=0, frozen reference boundary profile, RossFast excluded.

T0.meaning: Vertical water storage and variably saturated matrix flow in the representative one-dimensional soil column.

T1.meaning: Water-mass conservation plus Darcy-Buckingham flow yields the one-dimensional Richards equation with admitted constitutive theta(h), K(h) and C=dtheta/dh.

T2.meaning: Layered vertical compartments exchange Darcy flux; explicit top/bottom interfaces and admitted source/sink terms close the 1D column process model.

T3.boundary: Equation is broad scientific lineage; RB1 activates only its frozen admitted profile.

T4.meaning: RB1 Full Richards REFERENCE, SWKIMPL=0, SWSOPHY=0, frozen reference boundary profile; no RossFast or scope broadening.

T5.meaning: Mass-conservative continuous initial-boundary-value problem over generic model time; calendar boundaries are not intrinsic.

T6.meaning: Implicit backward finite-difference compartment discretisation using actual water-content storage difference and internodal Darcy flux; frozen RB1 uses the admitted explicit-conductivity-linearization route.

T7.meaning: Reference Newton-Raphson residual solve with Jacobian/tridiagonal linear solve, full-step attempt, backtracking and admitted convergence/mass criteria; surrounding transaction owns retry/commit.

capabilities.rb1_scope: Restricted reference ET partition and drought-only precomputed-QROT root-water-uptake profile already admitted to RB1.

T0.meaning: Atmospheric evaporative demand partitioned into potential transpiration/surface demand, followed by drought-limited root extraction from soil.

T1.meaning: Potential root extraction is distributed by root fraction and reduced on the released drought branch of the Feddes pressure-head response; broader wet/oxygen/salinity/process-based root physics is excluded.

T2.meaning: Reference ET demand -> explicit ptra handoff -> rooted-compartment potential sink -> pressure-head drought reduction -> actual root sink; actual transpiration is attribution of the same sink, not second mass.

relations: alpha_dry=0 below h4, linear h4..h3, 1 above h3 within released drought profile
T3.reference_et_partition: ET_ref partitioning by cover, crop factor, pond factor and CO2 factor as frozen in mod_reference_et_demand_process

T4.meaning: Frozen ET route SWETR=1, SWMETDETAIL=0, SWCFBS=0, SWINTER=0 plus released drought-only precomputed-QROT root profile.

T5.meaning: Direct algebraic process rates over the caller interval; root-extraction rate enters the soil-water balance once.

T6.rationale: No independent ET/root spatial/time state discretisation is introduced. Evaluation uses existing soil compartments/root fractions; water-state discretisation belongs to RB1-SW-REFERENCE.

T7.rationale: The released ET/root process is direct algebraic evaluation and has no independent Newton/linear/adaptive solver. Water-state advancement and acceptance belong to the soil-water solver/transaction route.

capabilities.rb1_scope: Stateless SWINTER=0, SWREDU=0 surface-evaporation profile already admitted to RB1.

T0.meaning: Evaporative water loss from an unponded soil surface or ponded surface to the atmosphere.

T1.meaning: Wet/ponded evaporation can meet demand; unponded dry-soil evaporation is constrained by hydraulic/Darcy supply. Black and Boesten/Stroosnijder empirical reductions are excluded from SWREDU=0.

T2.meaning: Atmospheric bare-soil/pond demand plus hydraulic ponding/capacity view produce one active evaporation route; evaluator is stateless and does not own authoritative mass booking.

relations: scientific-lineage hydraulic capacity: E_max=K_1/2*((h_atm-h_1-z_1)/z_1) under manual convention

T4.meaning: Frozen stateless SWINTER=0, SWREDU=0 profile only; no Black/Boesten-Stroosnijder cumulative-state route and no performance/scaling admission.

T5.meaning: Local algebraic boundary-flux rate law; persistent surface/soil storage advancement remains outside the evaluator and authoritative mass is booked once.

T6.rationale: The stateless evaluator has no independent temporal or spatial state discretisation; hydraulic capacity comes from the already discretised soil-water system.

T7.rationale: The evaluator is direct branch/min algebra and has no nonlinear solver, retry or time-step controller.
